thread.title: checkbox incorrect and plot not working in shiny

author: RedEyeUser
title: checkbox incorrect and plot not working in shiny
text:
I need the codes to be in a checkbox not dropdown, and for the plot to work.
SCRIPT:
library(shiny) library(ggplot2) library(dplyr) stocks <- read.csv("stocks.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE) company <- stocks$company volume <- stocks$volume closeprice <- stocks$closePrice code <- stocks$code date <- stocks$date ui <- fluidPage( titlePanel("Stock Price and Volume Movement January 2000 to July 2017"), sidebarLayout( sidebarPanel( selectInput("var_selection1", label = "Please choose a variable...", choices = list("Volume Traded" = 'volume', "Close Price" = 'closeprice'), selected = 'volume'), sliderInput("date", "Dates:", min = as.Date("2000-01-03","%Y-%m-%d"), max = as.Date("2017-07-31","%Y-%m-%d"), value=as.Date("2017-07-31"), timeFormat="%Y-%m-%d" ), checkboxInput("code", "Company Code", FALSE), verbatimTextOutput("code"), uiOutput("codeOutput") ), mainPanel( plotOutput("coolplot"), br(), br(), tableOutput("results") ) ) ) server <- function(input, output) { output$codeOutput <- renderUI({ selectInput("codeInput1", "Code", sort(unique(stocks$code)), selected = "AAPL") }) filtered <- reactive({ if (is.null(input$codeInput)) { return(NULL) } stocks %>% filter(closeprice >= input$dateInput[1], closeprice <= input$dateInput[2], code1 == input$codeInput1, ) }) output$coolplot <- renderPlot({ if (is.null(filtered())) { return() } ggplot(filtered(), aes(date)) + geom_bar() }) output$results <- renderTable({ filtered() }) } shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)
Data:
